rationale: The failure occurred on a Genius landing page with a duplicate locale segment and a hash fragment, leading to a non-PLP experience and likely a consent/legal gate. Normalizing locale to 'en-int' and stripping fragments prevents landing on editorial/anchor sections. Adding resilient PLP/PDP selectors targets Moncler’s SFCC-style grids and schema attributes, while consent dismissal improves reliability. URL blocking avoids corporate domain traps.
code_hints: Before navigation, apply URL canonicalization: strip fragments ('#...') and normalize locale to '/en-int/'.

If path contains '/genius/shop-genius/', do not assume it's a PLP. After page load, search for a PLP container ([data-component='product-list'], [data-testid='plp-grid'], .product-grid). If absent, click the first visible CTA containing 'Shop', 'Shop now', or 'Shop the collection' to reach the actual PLP.
Always attempt to dismiss cookie/consent banners once using click_once_selectors before PLP extraction.
When extracting PLP items, prefer anchors matching a[href*='/products/'] within the grid; they are stable PDP links on Moncler.
Set Accept-Language to an English preference to reduce locale/geo gates; avoid relying on geo-detected locales.
If PLP selectors are not found within a reasonable timeout, re-canonicalize current URL to '/en-int/' and retry once to bypass regional traps.
